frictions.description: Chrome DevTools MCP browser session was unavailable because chrome-profile was already locked by another running browser instance.
frictions.resolution: Retried browser tool calls (list_pages and new_page) without disruptive restarts; remained blocked.

blockers.description: Browser validation surface unavailable: Chrome DevTools MCP returned profile-lock error and could not open/select pages for localhost UI flows.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried browser calls and attempted direct new_page navigation; no recovery without disruptive browser/process restart.
